name: Ombre Perfumed Body Mist - Munsell Dream - 120ml
description:
Surround yourself in a dream of soft scents, reminding that you are always cherished and adored. An Amber Floral Fragrance, blending Peach, and Mandarin Orange with a rich base of Musk and Blackberry. Spray the mist directly on your skin focusing on the nerve points like wrists and neck.

All-day protection against sweat odor
Long-lasting fragrance
Quick absorption, non-greasy
Inspired by J'adore by Dior
